tools.name: get_llc_fees
tools.description: Returns one US state's LLC formation fee, its recurring annual-report or franchise-tax cost and cadence, online processing time, and known gotchas such as publication requirements, plus a labeled list of the official state source URLs the figures were taken from (dataset verified 2026). Use when the user asks what it costs to form or keep an LLC in a specific state. Covers all 50 states + DC.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. "WY" or "Wyoming". All 50 states + DC.

tools.name: compare_llc_costs
tools.description: Ranks US states by LLC cost: the one-time formation fee, the recurring state fee, or the first-year total (formation plus one recurring period). Use when the user asks which state is cheapest to form or maintain an LLC in, or wants LLC costs compared across specific states. Covers all 50 states + DC. State fees only — registered-agent fees, service fees, and revenue-based taxes are excluded. Returns figures only, without source URLs; get_llc_fees returns a state's official sources.

states.description: State codes or names to compare. Omit to rank all 50 states + DC.

sortBy.description: Which cost to sort ascending by. Defaults to firstYear (formation + one recurring period).

limit.description: How many states to return. Defaults to 10.

tools.name: get_annual_report_deadline
tools.description: Calculates when an LLC's next annual report or franchise tax is due in a given state and the amount owed, and returns the state's rule text, late-filing consequences where the dataset has them (penaltyAndNotes), and the official state source URLs. Use when the user asks when their LLC's annual report is due, how often it is filed, or what happens if it is late. States that key the deadline to the formation anniversary or quarter need formationDate; without it the tool says so instead of guessing a date.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. "WY" or "Wyoming". All 50 states + DC.

formationDate.description: The LLC's formation date as ISO yyyy-mm-dd. Required for anniversary- and quarter-based states.

tools.name: check_llc_name
tools.description: Screens a proposed business name against state naming rules. It does NOT search any state registry and cannot tell whether a name is already taken. Wyoming and Delaware: the entity designator where the statute requires one (such as "LLC"), words that are restricted or need agency approval (such as "Bank"; in Wyoming also "Trust" or "University"), and other state-specific rules. Florida: the required designator only. Other states and DC return verdict "unsupported" with a note pointing to the state's official name search. Verdicts: "conflict" means the name as written breaks a rule that blocks filing, including a missing required designator (reasons include a "Try:" suggestion where one applies); "uncertain" means no blocking rule was found (reasons may still list warnings) and availability is unverified. Wyoming, Delaware, and Florida results include verifyUrl, the state's official name search. Use when the user proposes a name for a new LLC or corporation in Wyoming, Delaware, or Florida.

name.description: The proposed name, e.g. "Blue Harbor Holdings LLC".

state.description: State code or name. Full naming-rule screen: "WY", "DE". Designator check + Sunbiz link: "FL". Other states return "unsupported".

tools.name: list_filing_states
tools.description: Lists FilingDesk's coverage: the states it files formations in today with all-in prices, the states its naming-rule screen supports, and fee/deadline data coverage (all 50 states + DC). Use when the user asks which states FilingDesk can file in, or before stating that FilingDesk can file in a particular state.

tools.name: compare_formation_options
tools.description: Returns fixed, factual tradeoffs for deciding WHERE to form (topic "state": the home state versus Wyoming, Delaware, and Nevada, including the cost of foreign-qualifying back into the home state) or WHAT entity type to use (topic "entity_type": LLC versus the S-corp tax election versus C-corp), plus a required disclaimer. Deliberately not a recommendation: the options are meant to be presented neutrally with the disclaimer, leaving the choice to the user. Use when the user asks which state to form in, whether to form out of state, or which entity type suits their business.

topic.description: "state" for where to form, "entity_type" for LLC vs S-corp vs C-corp.

homeState.description: Optional. The state the user actually lives or operates in — lets the comparison include their home-state costs, which usually matter most.

tools.name: preview_order
tools.description: Validates and prices a formation order and returns the exact summary that would be submitted, WITHOUT submitting anything (no side effects). Use when the user wants FilingDesk to form their LLC or corporation and has provided the business name, state, entity type, and their name, email, and phone. The returned summary is meant to be shown to the user verbatim, and this step is required before submit_order.

businessName.description: Proposed company name. Does not need to be final — a specialist verifies availability.

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. "WY" or "Wyoming". All 50 states + DC.

entityType.description: Entity type, e.g. "LLC", "S-Corp", "C-Corp", or "Not sure" if the user hasn't decided.

description.description: One or two sentences on what the business does. Optional — the user may skip it.

email.description: The customer's email. Required — this is where documents go. Temporary/disposable inboxes are rejected.

phone.description: The customer's phone number with area code. Required — used only if the state or the specialist has a question about the filing.

tools.name: submit_order
tools.description: Submits a formation order to FilingDesk. THIS HAS A REAL-WORLD EFFECT: it records the order, notifies a FilingDesk specialist, and may send an automatic order-confirmation email to the customer's email address. The specialist then reviews the order, confirms name availability and the price, and emails a payment link. Nothing is charged at submission. Call only after preview_order, once the user has explicitly confirmed that summary (userConfirmed: true). Returns the order reference (FD-…).

state.description: Two-letter state code or full state name, e.g. "WY" or "Wyoming". All 50 states + DC.

userConfirmed.description: Must be true. Set only after the user has seen the preview_order summary and explicitly agreed to submit.
